title: Runtime BiDi Structural Verification Catches Right-to-Left Layout Defects that Accessibility, Actionability, and Logical-Property Linting Miss
abstract: arXiv:2610.32934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bidirectional (right-to-left, RTL) layout defects arise when interfaces authored with physical directional CSS (margin-left, border-left, text-align:left) are rendered under dir="rtl" without being mirrored. Accessibility engines (axe-core), actionability engines (Playwright), and even Stylelint's current core logical-property rule fail to localise these defects. We present runtime structural invariants -- a zero-golden mode over computed style and geometry, and a bidi-conservative differential mode -- that catch them in a headless browser. On a held-out benchmark of 14 real RTL bugs reconstructed from dated fix commits in Bootstrap and Material Components Web, the detector recovers 13/14 (2 via zero-golden, 11 via the differential mode), with no false alarm on any patched version; on the actual committed historical bootstrap.rtl.css it catches 1 of 2 attempted. translated_title: 运行时双向结构验证可捕获无障碍性、可操作性与逻辑属性代码检查所遗漏的从右到左布局缺陷
translated_abstract: 双向（从右到左，RTL）布局缺陷产生于使用物理方向CSS属性（如margin-left、border-left、text-align:left）编写的界面在dir="rtl"环境下渲染时未被正确镜像的情况。无障碍性引擎、可操作性引擎，甚至Stylelint当前的核心逻辑属性规则都无法定位这些缺陷。我们提出了运行时结构不变量方法——基于计算样式与几何信息的零基准模式，以及双向保守差分模式——可在无头浏览器中捕获这些缺陷。在一个由Bootstrap和Material Components Web中带日期的修复提交重建的14个真实RTL缺陷的留出基准测试中，检测器成功恢复了13/14个缺陷（2个通过零基准模式，11个通过差分模式），且在所有已修复版本上零误报；在实际提交的历史版本bootstrap.rtl.css上，它在2次尝试中捕获了1个。该方法在16个负向LTR孤岛测试用例上报告了0个误报，并在两种模式下……
tldr: 该论文提出运行时结构不变量方法（零基准模式与双向保守差分模式），可在无头浏览器中检测出现有无障碍、可操作性和逻辑属性检查工具无法发现的RTL布局镜像缺陷，在真实基准上实现13/14的召回率且零误报。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces runtime structural invariants (a zero-golden mode and a bidi-conservative differential mode) that catch RTL layout mirroring defects in headless browsers—defects that accessibility, actionability, and logical-property linting tools miss—achieving 13/14 recall on real-world benchmarks with zero false positives.
